_comment: WO-OR-24 fixture — the shape `gh api repos/<owner>/<name>/issues/<n>/comments` actually returns, copied from the real response for warwickallan/Fusion247PKA PR #87 on 2026-08-02. __HEAD_SHA__, __FINDING_A__ and __FINDING_B__ are substituted at test time because finding ids are uuids generated by the database and the head moves. Everything else — field names, nesting, the noise comment — is what GitHub delivers. This is a FIXTURE FOR THE SEAM, not for the ingest path: it is what the injected `gh` double replies with so the suite needs no network. The live journey is driven by the real API, never by this file.
